messages:
emma-sales: Heads-up: HelixBank POC request for Private deployment. Must: (1) preserve client src IP for forensic logs, (2) provide a single static egress IP for allowlisting, (3) be compatible with their inline TLS inspection. They attached a compliance checklist. Can eng propose a minimal topology + checklist?
raj-netops: Quick options: A) PrivateLink + customer-side egress proxy that NATs to one IP and emits a signed header with original IP. B) Routed VPC peering/transit to preserve L3 src IP. C) Dedicated connector VM in customer VPC that forwards unchanged. Tradeoffs: A = low routing change; B = literal src IP but more routing ops; C = middle ground but billable.
lina-se: If they accept app-layer evidence, recommend option A with HMAC-signed header. Example headers: X-Orig-Client-IP and X-Orig-Client-IP-Sig (HMAC_SHA256 over "<ts>|<client-ip>|<request-id>"). Our ingress verifies signature and logs result.
tom-arch: Minimal pasteable firewall allowlist (public-egress path):
- 203.0.113.55/32 TCP 443 (redwood-ingress-a)
- 203.0.113.56/32 TCP 443 (redwood-ingress-b)
- NTP UDP 123 to corporate NTP
- DNS TCP/UDP 53 to corporate resolver
If PrivateLink: allow proxy host to reach interface ENI(s) per onboarding doc.
raj-netops: Ops caveats: watch MTU and MSS across IPSec/SD-WAN; set proxy healthcheck on 8080; tune NAT timeouts for streaming. For signed-header approach, we require KMS-backed keys and a rotation cadence.
emma-sales: Customer says network-layer src IP is preferred but will consider signed header if Redwood provides a cryptographic attestation that we verify and persist signatures for the POC. Can we do that?
compliance-bot: Compliance note: we can provide a scoped attestation for the POC: "Redwood verifies HMAC on X-Orig-Client-IP (HMAC-SHA256) and persists the header plus verification outcome to immutable audit logs for the POC period." Requirement: customer must attest that TLS-inspect operators do NOT hold HMAC signing KMS keys and provide rotation schedule. Legal must approve final wording.
lina-se: Pricing: dedicated connector is an add-on (onboarding + monthly infra + egress). PrivateLink+proxy POC is typically lower cost. I'll ask pricing ops for a 30-day POC delta and post here.
tom-arch: Action owners: Lina -> proxy config + HMAC pseudocode; Raj -> pasteable netops checklist & MTU notes; Emma -> send attestation ask to customer and confirm KMS constraints. Can we target handoff by EOD tomorrow?
emma-sales: Yes, customer wants to start connectivity tests mid next week. Thanks team :thumbsup:
compliance-bot: Reminder: create ticket POC-1307 for eng-oncall and route to network onboarding."
